name: Soft Voronoi Decomposition
definition: A differentiable spatial partitioning method used to decompose a scene into N regions (Voronoi cells) defined by a set of N sites φ ∈ R^(N×3). It solves the problem of creating a smooth, differentiable decomposition that approximates a hard Voronoi diagram, allowing gradients to flow to the site positions φ during training.
summary: Soft Voronoi Decomposition is a differentiable spatial partitioning method that approximates hard Voronoi diagrams with smooth weights, enabling gradient flow to site positions while providing cache-friendly memory access and efficient inference.
